Messages.Author: BenPeal
Messages.Body:
Quick search digs up these:

Set's Curse
Basilisk's Touch
Entombment
Liquify the Mortal Coil
Still the Mortal Flesh
Autonomic Mastery (non-wraith allies)
The Secret Must Be Kept
Veles' Hunt
Kindred Segregation

Permanent Vacation removes an ally from the game rather than burning, but if you're counting that, then add Chair of Hades to the list.

There are probably some crypt cards with ally-burning specials. Kamiri wa Itherero has one, I think.
